Name: Moony's Cornucopia and SVE CC Bundles
Author: MoonyIsTired
Description:
[b]DESCRIPTION:

[/b]This is a CC bundle mod designed to be mildly challenging by requiring a high variety of items in multiple quantity, however all items are possible to be acquired in Year 1 and with some planning and dedication you should be able to finish it by your first winter if so desired! This is for the players that have gotten too used to the experience of the vanilla CC but still want to be able to go to Ginger Island before their second spring.

This mod and its rewards were also partially inspired on Minerva's Harder Bundles, which was my go-to CC mod before Stardew 1.5!

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia Crops[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia Flowers[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia Artisan Goods[/url]﻿ and their necessary dependencies. (Only Essential Packs needed for Cornucopia)
[*]Download and unzip this mod into the Mods folder
[*]Run the game using SMAPI

[/list]
[b]COMPATIBILITY:

[/b]This mod is for Stardew Valley 1.6!
Of course, compatible with (and requires) Stardew Valley Expanded and the Cornucopia series of mods.
Should be compatible with any other mods that add items. Feel free to use my own edit as a base if you'd like to add items from even more mods into the pack!
Not compatible with any other mod that edits the CC Bundles and Missing Bundle.
